name: browser_tabs
description: List this chat’s tabs and working tab.

name: browser_open
description: Open a URL in a new working tab.

name: browser_navigate
description: Navigate the working or named tab; creates the first tab.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

name: browser_resize
description: Set the viewport in CSS pixels.

name: browser_snapshot
description: Read a compact accessibility snapshot with element IDs, including frames. For large pages use interactive_only (controls and headings) or follow next_offset with the same options. Offset 0 starts a fresh snapshot; continuation pages retain all earlier IDs.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

offset.description: Continue the cached snapshot at next_offset; omit or use 0 to refresh.

interactive_only.description: Show interactive roles and context headings only. Keep the same value for continuation pages.

name: browser_screenshot
description: Return a JPEG image; optional path saves inside the chat folder.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

name: browser_wait_for
description: Wait for rendered text anywhere in the page or its frames, including open shadow roots. Polls every 250 ms in isolated worlds.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

name: browser_evaluate
description: Evaluate JavaScript, await promises; output limited to 20 KiB. Default timeout 10 seconds.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

name: browser_console
description: Read up to 500 recorded console entries; optional clear.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

name: browser_network
description: Read up to 500 network entries. Only request_id explicitly retrieves a bounded response body.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

name: browser_click
description: Click an element from the latest snapshot.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.

tab.description: Owned tab ID; defaults to this chat’s working tab.
